headword: {情報漏洩|じょうほうろうえい}

definitions.gloss: information leak; data breach; disclosure of confidential information
definitions.explanation: The unauthorized release or leaking of confidential, personal, or classified information. A major concern in business, government, and cybersecurity.

examples.japanese: {情報漏洩|じょうほうろうえい}が{発覚|はっかく}した。
{個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}の{漏洩|ろうえい}を{防|ふせ}ぐ{対策|たいさく}を{講|こう}じる。
examples.english: To implement measures to prevent personal information leaks.

examples.japanese: {社員|しゃいん}の{不注意|ふちゅうい}による{情報漏洩|じょうほうろうえい}で{会社|かいしゃ}は{大|おお}きな{損害|そんがい}を{被|こうむ}った。
examples.english: The company suffered major losses from an information leak caused by an employee's carelessness.

notes: Composed of {情報|じょうほう} (information) + {漏洩|ろうえい} (leaking, disclosure). A frequently used term in news and business. Common collocations: {情報漏洩|じょうほうろうえい}を{防|ふせ}ぐ (to prevent an information leak), {情報漏洩|じょうほうろうえい}{事件|じけん} (data breach incident), {情報漏洩|じょうほうろうえい}{対策|たいさく} (data leak prevention measures). Japan's {個人情報保護法|こじんじょうほうほごほう} (Act on Protection of Personal Information) sets strict requirements for handling personal data. {漏洩|ろうえい} can also be read {漏泄|ろうせつ}, though {ろうえい} is the standard reading.
